activities.title: Society Pool Swimming and Water Play
activities.instructions: Head to your society's pool for fun, sustained water play. Start with a gentle warm-up by practicing flutter kicks while holding onto the pool edge to build leg strength. Next, practice basic arm strokes by encouraging your child to reach and scoop the water with paddle strokes while moving short distances toward you. Keep the activity active and continuous for 20 to 30 minutes with interactive games like gliding with a kickboard or pretending to swim like friendly sea animals, helping build swimming technique and stamina.

activities.title: Clubhouse Court Tennis Rallies
activities.instructions: Head down to your clubhouse courts with child-sized racquets and low-compression tennis balls or foam balls. Start with a warm-up by balancing a ball on the racquet while walking along the court lines. Next, stand close together on either side of the net (or along the service line) and gently tap the ball back and forth, aiming to keep a rally going. To practice accuracy and tracking, set up targets like cones or markers on the court for your child to aim for when hitting.
